 USER {
 bigint id PK

 varchar password

 }

 AUTHOR {
 bigint id PK
 varchar first_name
 varchar last_name
 text biography
 date birth_date
 datetime created_at
 datetime updated_at
 }

 BOOK {
 bigint id PK
 varchar isbn UK
 varchar title
 text description
 varchar publisher
 date publication_date
 integer total_copies
 integer available_copies
 boolean is_active
 datetime created_at
 datetime updated_at
 }

 BOOK_AUTHOR {
 bigint id PK
 bigint book_id FK
 bigint author_id FK
 datetime created_at
 }

 LOAN {
 bigint id PK
 bigint book_id FK
 bigint user_id FK
 datetime borrowed_at
 datetime due_date
 datetime returned_at
 varchar status
 text notes
 datetime created_at
 datetime updated_at
 }
